{{Quote|I bring you warmest greetings and congratulations from the Emperor.|Jahan Cross to Bail Organa|<ref name="AOTE" />}}
The '''25th anniversary''' of the settling of the [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]] took place in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. On that occasion, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] and [[First Chairman/Legends|First Chairman]] of the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]], held a gala reception in the [[Grand Reception Room]] of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]]. Among the many guests were the [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Adan Dooku]] and his son [[Bron Dooku|Bron]], as well as the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] envoy [[Jahan Cross]]. They were all welcomed by Organa himself, accompanied by his daughter [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and her friend [[Winter Celchu|Winter]]. Following the reception, some of the invited dignitaries were offered accommodation in the palace. Officially, Cross had come to pass on the good wishes of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. However, unbeknownst to the Organas, he had also been tasked with [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] Dooku, and he took advantage of the night that followed the gala to accomplish his plan.<ref name="AOTE" />
